organic_results.title: Versova Koliwada Street Art Walk & Hidden Murals
organic_results.snippet: Take a self-guided trail through 200-year-old fishing village alleys covered with giant vibrant marine murals by Mumbai and international street artists.

organic_results.title: Second-Hand Book Bargain Hunt outside Andheri Station
organic_results.snippet: Hidden beneath the suburban railway awnings, pavement stalls sell vintage paperbacks, translated classics, and old architecture magazines from ₹50.

organic_results.title: Silent Walking Meditation: Gilbert Hill Basalt Monolith
organic_results.snippet: A 66-million-year-old volcanic rock column in the middle of bustling Andheri West with steep steps and panoramic view of the suburban canopy.

organic_results.title: Mahakali Caves: Ancient Buddhist Rock-Cut Monasteries
organic_results.snippet: Nineteen basalt caves carved between 1st century BCE and 6th century CE tucked away in Andheri East surrounded by quiet banyan trees.
